name: support-escalation-bundle
description: Generates a structured, redacted Google Cloud Support escalation bundle when a GKE issue requires Google-side control plane intervention, quota adjustments, or platform bug escalation. Use when diagnostics confirm the root cause is outside customer-managed Kubernetes/GitOps state (such as stuck GKE control plane operations, regional stockouts with no fallback, or internal GKE control plane errors). Don't use when the issue can be resolved directly via customer-side manifest, node pool, or IAM configuration changes.
